about: R2-CAPTAIN-ANIMATION CA1 pilot clip plan (D-102): which painted frame is each clip frame. Jog: 4 painted frames are a half cycle; the back view's second half is the first half mirrored (the identity is mirror-safe), the profile's second half repeats the first (the near and far legs read alike at 81-161 px). Idle: one standing frame per facing. Guides: guides.json (pose-guide rig, elevation 29 deg); the full set is pinned in guides.sha256 (gs://stapledons-voyage-assets/captain/<sha256>.png).
